title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.05141v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Context lengths of language models (LMs) have dramatically increased, driven by the demands for in-context learning, self-improvement, and long-horizon agentic workflows. However, existing long-context corpora are dominated by books, academic articles, and code repositories, which are finite and often lack long-distance dependencies. In this work, we introduce OctoLong, a context-engineering pipeline that instruments an AST parser, a language server backend, and a package manager to recursively retrieve code references, enabling the curation of dependency-rich code contexts up to millions of tokens long. We then train OctoLong-Instruct, a suite of capable long-context open LMs, derived from base models ranging in size from 600M to 14B parameters, via context-extension mid-training on a approx 50B-token mixture containing approx 6.2B tokens of OctoLong code contexts, followed by approx 10B tokens of instruction tuning. translated_title: OctoLong：在跨仓库代码上下文上进行中期训练以增强长上下文建模
translated_abstract: 在上下文学习、自我改进和长程智能体工作流需求的推动下，语言模型（LM）的上下文长度已大幅增加。然而，现有的长上下文语料库以书籍、学术文章和代码仓库为主，这些语料不仅数量有限，而且往往缺乏长距离依赖关系。在这项工作中，我们提出了OctoLong，这是一个上下文工程流水线，它结合AST解析器、语言服务器后端和包管理器来递归检索代码引用，从而能够整理出长达数百万token、依赖关系丰富的代码上下文。随后，我们训练了OctoLong-Instruct，这是一套功能强大的长上下文开源语言模型，其基础模型参数规模从600M到14B不等，通过对包含约62亿token OctoLong代码上下文的约500亿token混合语料进行上下文扩展中期训练，随后再进行约100亿token的指令微调。我们的消融实验...
tldr: OctoLong通过整合AST解析器、语言服务器和包管理器递归检索跨仓库代码引用，构建了长达数百万token且依赖关系丰富的代码上下文，并以此进行中期训练，显著增强了开源语言模型的长上下文建模能力。
en_tdlr: OctoLong is a context-engineering pipeline that leverages AST parsers, language servers, and package managers to recursively retrieve cross-repository code references, curating dependency-rich code contexts up to millions of tokens, and mid-training on such contexts substantially enhances long-context modeling of open LMs.
